description:
For Everything, Everyday
The E-506 SUV is the capable, durable, versatile and effortlessly enjoyable e-bike for everything your everyday demands. The perfect way to swap the ever-increasing cost, congestion and frustration of urban car use for a healthier, happier, more efficient and more economical way to move. Safe and secure. Fast and fun. Versatile and helpful. For school, shopping, socialising or just taking time out for your heart and head. Whatever you’re doing, the E-506 SUV is a better way of living the life you love.

Highlights
– Powerful and reliable Bosch Performance Line CX 85Nm motor
– Large capacity Bosch PowerTube 500Wh removable battery
– Simple and durable 1x10 Shimano LinkGlide transmission
– Four-piston hydraulic disc brakes for dependable all-weather braking
– Integrated lights front and rear
– Tough alloy rear rack to carry whatever you need
– ‘Dropper’ seatpost lets raise and lower the saddle as you ride
– Full set of mudguards front and rear

Why E-506 SUV?
Capable, versatile, practical, tough. We designed our E-506 SUV bike to be the most valuable life upgrade you can make.

The Total Geometry handling of our multi award-winning mountain bikes lets you take streets, short cuts, and carrying shopping or the kids in your stride. Wide, high volume tyres, a proper suspension fork, an upright position and a comfortable frame don’t just make the E-506 SUV a pleasure to ride – they can also open up a whole world of back road, bike path, short cut and trekking trail options where no cars means carefree fun. The super confident handling character and intelligent power assist also takes all the stress out of riding letting you fully appreciate the freedom, mindfulness, and joy of movement the E-506 SUV can bring, wherever you take it.

Investing in the E-506 SUV starts paying back from the first pedal stroke and not just in the serious amount of cash you’re not burning by turning an ignition key or buying a ticket. We’ve built toughness and reliability into every aspect of the design too. Frame and fork are full mountain bike spec and registering your bike gives you a full four-year frame warranty. Bosch motors have by far the best reputation for reliability, and they’re expertly supported by our fully trained dealer network and Bosch’s own UK service centre. Balloon tyres are perfect for bouncing up and down kerbs and the Shimano LinkGlide gearing is engineered specifically for an epic lifespan with minimal maintenance.

Features & Equipment
We’ve partnered with Bosch to create the effortlessly enabling, electric heart of the E-506 SUV. Five different pedal assistance modes from the ‘cruise for hours’ efficiency of Eco to the climb flattening power of Boost put safer, easier, further and faster riding right under your thumb. The integrated, lockable fast-charging 500Wh battery is secure and sleek but can be removed easily for home charging or streetwise safety.

The mid-frame motor means none of the weird steering or wheel spin issues of hub motor bikes; super-sized road tyres and RockShox mountain bike suspension forks mix limousine smooth luxury and easy speed with Land Rover capability and toughness. Grips and saddle are carefully chosen to be super comfortable whatever you’re wearing or how far you’re riding.

Push button seat lowering thanks to our own Whyte Drop.it dropper seatpost means feet flat on the floor reassurance for stress free starting and stopping and the integrated kick stand makes parking a breeze. Shimano’s ultra-durable, e-bike-optimised LinkGlide gearing makes a swift getaway in town as easy as getting away over the hills at the weekend. Powerful four-piston hydraulic disc brakes put you in complete command whatever the weather and automatically adjust for pad wear too.

Because we know how much of a part of your daily life this bike will become, we’ve also fully loaded it for everything your everyday demands. Tough alloy rack, full mudguards and built-in lights powered from the main battery let you mix business and pleasure 24/7.

e-BIKE SPECIFIC SPECIFICATION

DRIVE UNIT Bosch Performance Line CX (25km/h) 85Nm
DISPLAY Bosch Purion Performance Line

BATTERY Bosch Power Tube PT500 Horizontal
BATTERY CHARGER 2A (100-240V)
